variants.text: ALERT. Atmosphere below tolerance for organic crew. This unit does not breathe. This unit is concerned regardless.

choices.text: What happened to the other six?

text: Reactor integrity {round(cond('reactor'))} percent. Life support {round(cond('life_support'))}. Water reclamation {round(cond('water_reclaim'))}. Hydroponics {round(cond('hydroponics'))}.

Power: {round(power_supply())} of {round(power_demand())} kilowatts requested. Air {round(res('air'))} percent. Water {round(res('water'))} litres. six.text: Units one through six are in the spares bin in Engineering. Unit four is this unit's left manipulator. Unit two is this unit's voice. This unit prefers not to dwell on it.

where.text: Chief Kowal: {activity('bram')}. Technician Anders: {activity('pip')}. Botanist Castellanos: {activity('wren')}. Dr. Suvari: {activity('lin')}. All crew are also listed in your datapad under CREW. This unit recommends reading it.
